key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6BD0
name: walk_nested_entry_list
description: Advances through a list of entries, either looking up a table entry and passing it with a second value to a called routine, or recursing into a sub-list whose result is combined with another call. It sets a state flag in the record and stores the new list position unless the next entry is the terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6C30
name: combine_two_calls_into_record
description: Calls a routine for a value, passes that value and its upper half to two further calls, and sets a flag word in the record to one. It stores the advanced list position when the next entry is not the terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6C90
name: store_stack_value_in_pointer
description: Copies a value from the stack frame into the location the first pointer register addresses, then returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:71CC
name: process_pending_byte_pairs
description: When the countdown byte is zero, it sends each byte pair with its high bit set to a table lookup and a called routine, then loads the next countdown byte from the stream, or clears the countdown at the terminator. When the countdown is nonzero, it decrements it instead. It returns whether a new step was taken.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:71E8
name: emit_pairs_then_load_count
description: If the flag word is zero, it sends the byte pairs at the current stream position to a table lookup and a called routine, then loads the next countdown byte or clears the countdown at the terminator. Otherwise it clears the countdown. It returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7246
name: load_next_counter_from_stream
description: Reads the next stream byte into the countdown field, or clears the field when the stream has reached its terminator, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:725A
name: fetch_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the byte at the current stream position into a field of the caller's structure, advances the position by one, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7268
name: clear_byte_flag_and_return
description: Sets a single byte field in the caller's structure to zero and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7272
name: refresh_cells_for_sprite_record
description: Builds a temporary record from the caller's words and refreshes the table cells it addresses through a called routine. It clears the matching per-cell byte for each refreshed cell, and when the record's secondary type is six, it repeats the update for a third cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:72DA
name: refresh_cells_for_position_record
description: Builds a record of fixed type from the position words of the argument, derives two cell indices from it, and refreshes those cells through called routines. It clears their per-cell bytes and, when the record's type field is six, does the same for a third cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7604
name: lookup_cell_byte_and_call
description: Derives a table index from the low word of the argument by masking and shifting it, then calls a routine with the cell byte from a lookup table and that index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7660
name: store_cell_type_and_attributes
description: Classifies a cell from two argument words, packs a three-bit type code with the flag bits into a per-cell byte, stores a companion value in a second table, and writes the entry word into a 32-byte record before making a call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:774E
name: clear_table_and_initialise_state
description: Zeroes 512 longwords at a fixed address, then calls a library routine with a buffer and a count of ten. It stores the returned value and derives two display values from a global flag, then calls two further routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: Calls routines to read a value and tests the zero flag. When the flag is set, it calls further routines and returns the value shifted right by one. Otherwise it stores the value and an extra register word into a table indexed by a register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:77FC
name: update_counter_on_equal_pointers
description: Returns at once unless the low bit of a data register is set and both address registers hold the same value. In that case it adds the gap between the two addresses to a stored counter and calls a routine through a function pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:783E
name: assemble_byte_from_bit_calls
description: Runs eight iterations that shift a word left, call a routine each time, and set the low bit when the shifted value was not zero. It builds one byte from those bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Reads 256 pairs of code length and symbol value from a source table and fills a local decoding table, expanding short codes across their entries and placing longer codes in second-level entries. It then copies the finished table into a fixed global area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7922
name: decode_huffman_symbols_to_buffer
description: Decodes symbols from a bit stream using the prepared table and writes them to the output pointer, as literal bytes or table values. It keeps the bit buffer, bit count and remaining count for the next call and returns the number of symbols decoded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7A3A
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7A4C
name: advance_counter_and_read_word
description: When the selector register is zero, it adds a fixed step of 512 to a stored counter, calls a routine through a function pointer, and returns a word. Otherwise it returns the word at the pointer without other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7A94
name: decode_symbols_and_pad_output
description: Decodes symbols from a bit stream into an output buffer up to the requested count, using the prepared table, and saves the bit state for the next call. It writes a zero pad byte at the end when the stored counter is even.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7BD8
name: read_aligned_value_with_mask
description: Clears a state word and calls a routine, then reads a byte or word from a stored pointer depending on its alignment. It stores that value and a mask shifted by the argument into state fields, then calls another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7C1A
name: add_gap_to_counter
description: Computes the distance from a stored pointer to an address 512 bytes further on, subtracts a word argument, adds the result to a stored counter, and calls a routine through a function pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7C34
name: clear_state_word_after_setup
description: Calls a routine on a fixed block with a size argument, runs three further routines, then clears a state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7C5A
name: select_routine_by_state_word
description: Calls a routine, then selects a follow-up call from a state word: zero and one each run one routine, and two runs another. For any other value it returns the state word minus two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7C8C
name: set_flags_and_run_routines
description: Runs a sequence of routine calls, sets two state words to one, makes an indirect call, runs two more calls when a state word is zero, and finishes with a final indirect call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7CCE
name: shift_history_table_and_store
description: Moves the 8-byte entries of a history table along by one slot, resets the table index to minus one, then copies a two-longword value from globals into the first slot and a second table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7D3C
name: shift_history_table_back
description: Decrements the table index, shifts the 8-byte entries back one slot, and writes a two-longword value from globals into the entry at the new index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7D96
name: initialise_game_state_words
description: Resets a set of state words, setting one counter to twenty-three and another to two hundred or zero depending on a flag byte. It selects a mode value from a table indexed by a counter and calls a final routine with a block address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7E28
name: run_eight_pass_update_loop
description: Calls a routine, then runs four routine calls on each of eight passes followed by one more call. It clears one state word and sets another to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7EBA
name: reset_index_and_copy_position
description: Sets a table index to minus one and copies a two-longword value from globals into a fixed structure field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7ED4
name: store_two_bytes_at_index
description: Stores the high and low bytes of the first argument into adjacent positions of a four-byte-stride table, indexed by the low word of the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7F00
name: run_wait_loop_until_done
description: Clears two state words and, when a first check passes, looks up a value from a 32-byte-stride table and starts a routine. It then loops calling routines and checking a timer word until a completion value is returned, after which it clears a mode word and sets a state word to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7F96
name: dispatch_state_handler_by_code
description: Clears a state word and dispatches on a one-byte state code through a switch. Each case runs a fixed set of routine calls, some conditional on table entries or the current position, and the state word is then reset before a shared routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:7FAC
name: call_routine_then_reset_state
description: Calls a routine, makes an indirect call through a function pointer, clears a state word, and calls one more routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:81DC
name: loop_dispatch_while_flag_set
description: Repeatedly clears a state word and dispatches on an index word to one of several routines, continuing while a flag equals two and a table entry at the current index equals one. It then clears the flag and returns the last routine result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8230
name: update_step_with_countdown_check
description: Runs four routine calls and resets several state words. It then either clears a timer-related word, or, when a count is positive, sets a busy flag, makes an indirect call, and checks a stored value. It finishes by setting the index to minus one and a mode word to one, then calls one more routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:82DE
name: show_side_resignation_message
description: Copies position words into state fields, then either continues the current move through several routine calls, or, when the stored counters fall outside the continue thresholds, displays the blue-side or red-side resignation text for the side that resigned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:84C4
name: return_immediately_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:84CC
name: return_with_no_effect
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:84D4
name: compute_count_and_init_fields
description: Looks up a count from a table using the low nibble of a value returned by a called routine, makes that many calls, then reads a six-bit value and makes that many further calls. It copies two longwords from globals into state and clears two state words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:857E
name: process_queue_until_threshold
description: Sets a busy flag and calls routines, then, while a position is below a stored threshold, calls a routine for each table entry until its marker is zero. It then copies the position into the threshold, or sets the threshold to 200 when the flag is set, and clears the busy flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:865A
name: scan_for_matching_entry
description: Increments a counter and, while the position is still below a limit, sets a flag. Otherwise it scans table entries with a routine call until a stored byte is zero, then compares a masked value with an expected code and processes the two adjacent entries when they match.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:874A
name: scan_balanced_byte_sequence
description: Reads a value and, when it is below 128, scans a run of values, adjusting a counter by their bit flags until it balances. It then reads a final value and returns the result of a routine call, or zero when the value does not match. Otherwise it returns the result of one routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:87BA
name: wait_until_bit_six_set
description: Repeatedly reads a value and calls a routine until that value has bit six set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:87DA
name: balance_counter_across_read_values
description: Decrements a stored counter, then repeatedly reads values, counting those at or above 128 upward and those with bit six set downward, until the two counts balance.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8818
name: exit_without_changes
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8820
name: store_pointer_result_pair
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer with a zero argument and stores its returned value in two adjacent longword state fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8838
name: record_elapsed_since_start
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer with a zero argument, stores the result, and stores its difference from a previously saved value in a state longword.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8858
name: accumulate_elapsed_into_slot
description: Calls a routine, then adds a stored elapsed value to a longword in a table indexed by the low word of the argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8876
name: forward_two_arguments_to_routine
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:888E
name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores a two-longword value from state into the table entry at the current slot, copies it into two further state fields, and calls a routine with the entry values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:88DE
name: advance_index_and_swap_pair
description: Advances an index and a counter word, calls a routine with its two arguments, then swaps two stored slot numbers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8916
name: swap_slots_and_decrement_counters
description: Swaps two stored slot numbers, calls a routine with its two arguments, then decrements a counter and an index word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8950
name: call_routine_around_table_lookup
description: Calls a routine with its arguments, passes a byte from a table indexed by a slot number to a second routine and keeps its result, then calls the first routine again with the same arguments and returns that result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:89AC
name: dispatch_command_code_word
description: Dispatches on the low byte of a command word through a switch. Some cases call routines, others set or toggle a flag byte, and two cases record a side in a state word and make a call when the value matches. The command word is then cleared and the routine returns the result of a final routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8B1E
name: skip_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8B26
name: invoke_global_function_pointer
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset in the global data block and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8CCA
name: set_timer_for_state_code
description: Stores the high byte of a state word into a code field, then sets a timer value by code: zero gives six, and ten calls a routine and uses its result as the timer. Other codes set five shifted by the code minus one, and the routine clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8CEE
name: set_timer_from_pending_code
description: When the state word is ten, calls a routine and either restores the state word from the caller's saved value or stores the result as the timer. Otherwise it sets the timer to five shifted by the state code minus one and clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8D0E
name: store_stack_word_in_state
description: Copies a word from the caller's stack frame into a fixed state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8D16
name: set_timer_and_clear_counters
description: Sets a timer to five shifted by the state code minus one and clears two longword counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8D32
name: set_timer_minimum_of_three
description: Sets a word flag to one, clears another word, and raises a timer value to at least three.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8D5C
name: copy_byte_array
description: Copies a count of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer, one byte at a time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8D84
name: compare_byte_sequences
description: Compares up to a count of bytes from two buffers. It returns zero when all compared bytes match, or the difference between the first pair that differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8DC4
name: reset_board_display_markers
description: Blanks each entry in a linked list of display rows, sets a group of flag bytes to one, then writes a plus character into the display cells selected by the current position and side states.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:8F9E
name: mark_matching_entries_in_bitmap
description: Clears a bitmap block, then repeatedly processes queued entries and, when an entry matches the given value and a routine returns zero, sets that entry's bit in the bitmap.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:901C
name: scan_until_target_match
description: Clears a result byte and steps through list entries until one matches the stored pair of coordinates, or until the active marker clears. It saves the matched pair, writes a fixed sentinel into the list, and returns the result byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9052
name: walk_until_position_repeats
description: Steps through entries while the active flag is set, stopping when the stored coordinates equal the last saved pair. It saves the coordinates on a match, writes a fixed sentinel into the list, and returns the result byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9082
name: pack_board_rows_into_bytes
description: Writes a header byte from state, then packs the type and colour bits of each square on an eight-by-eight board from a four-byte-stride table, two squares per byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9132
name: render_board_squares_with_state
description: Stores a side value from the argument into one state word and its opposite into another, then walks the eight-by-eight board calling routines for each square. It finishes with several more calls and two indirect calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:91F0
name: check_red_piece_limits
description: Counts each side's pieces and returns a message pointer for the first count outside its limit, such as too many Red pieces. Otherwise it may run a further check through called routines and returns a message or null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9290
name: check_blue_piece_limits
description: Counts each side's pieces and returns a message pointer for the first count outside its limit, such as too many Blue pieces. Otherwise it may run a further check through called routines and returns a message or null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:92A0
name: check_red_king_limit
description: Returns the too-many-kings message for Red when the side has two or more kings. Otherwise it checks the king's neighbouring squares against the opposing king and returns a message or null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:92B0
name: check_blue_king_limit
description: Returns the too-many-kings message for Blue when the side has two or more kings. Otherwise it checks the king's neighbouring squares against the opposing king and returns a message or null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:92C0
name: check_red_king_present
description: Returns the missing-king message when Red has no king on the board. Otherwise it checks whether the kings are adjacent through the neighbour table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:92D0
name: check_blue_king_present
description: Returns the missing-king message when Blue has no king on the board. Otherwise it checks whether the kings are adjacent through the neighbour table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:92E0
name: check_kings_adjacent
description: Compares the king's square with each of the eight neighbouring offsets and returns the kings-adjacent message when one matches. Otherwise it runs a further check through a called routine and returns a message or null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:931C
name: check_blue_king_in_check
description: Returns the check message when one of the eight neighbour offsets matches the king's square, or when a further attack test succeeds. Otherwise it returns null.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:935E
name: return_red_check_message
description: Returns the pointer to the Red-in-check message text without further checks.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9368
name: return_zero_result
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:942E
name: reset_threshold_after_calls
description: Calls two routines, then clears a stored threshold word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9442
name: return_smaller_half_word
description: Compares the low and high words of its argument and returns the smaller of the two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:945E
name: return_larger_half_word
description: Compares the low and high words of its argument and returns the larger of the two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:947A
name: return_absolute_word_value
description: Returns the low word of its argument, negated when it is zero or below, so the result is a non-negative magnitude.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9494
name: check_pending_pairs_until_clear
description: Updates a counter around two routine calls, then repeatedly checks a stored pair with a routine while the active flag is set. It returns one when a check reports zero, and zero when the flag is clear.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:94D8
name: show_end_of_game_text
description: Displays one of two end-of-game texts, chosen by whether a test on the current side's king succeeds. The side values are swapped in one branch before the text is shown.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:959C
name: search_candidate_target_squares
description: Saves the previous source and target squares and reads the piece on the selected square. When a flag is set, it scans candidate target squares with a routine call until one is accepted and records it. Otherwise it clears the saved target.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:969E
name: decode_square_flags_into_state
description: Reads a two-byte entry from a table at the position given by the argument and stores its first byte in a state word. It decodes the second byte into two-bit state fields and three one-bit flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9746
name: encode_square_state_into_bytes
description: Writes two bytes into a two-byte-stride table at the given index: the first from a state byte, the second packed from the flag and two-bit state fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:97AA
name: mark_target_square_pending
description: Copies a stored target pair into position fields. Unless the target is empty or its state byte is already one or six, it sets that state byte to six, clears the target and calls a routine. It returns one when the change was made, otherwise zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9808
name: refresh_pending_square_state
description: When a state word equals two, it calls two routines on a stored pointer. It then calls routines with a stored byte and a stored word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9860
name: read_byte_at_offset
description: Calls a routine with an address made from a base pointer plus the argument's low word, then reads one byte and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9898
name: test_result_is_zero
description: Calls a routine with its two arguments and returns true when that routine returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:98BE
name: call_fixed_block_with_zero
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer, passing the address of a fixed block and a zero value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:98D6
name: initialise_square_tables
description: Sets 120 entries of one table to sixteen, zeroes two rows of sixteen bytes in a 32-byte-stride table, sets two words to minus one, and calls a routine with that pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:995A
name: index_pieces_by_type
description: Scans the board in a fixed walking pattern and, for each piece type from one to six, records the square of every matching piece in a per-type list and counts it. It calls a routine when the type-six pass begins.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9A9A
name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: The pseudo-code could not be produced, so the behaviour is not known from the evidence. The routine is 24 instructions long and is called from two unnamed routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9AE2
name: swap_table_entries_store_byte
description: Swaps two four-byte table entries whose indices are the argument's low and high words, then writes the argument's second byte into a cell of a 32-byte-stride table selected by the first index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9B6C
name: clear_entry_and_cell
description: Clears the first byte of a four-byte table entry selected by the argument's low word, and clears a matching cell in a 32-byte-stride table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9BB6
name: store_move_pair_in_table
description: Stores the low byte of the first argument and its second byte into a four-byte table entry selected by the low word of the second argument, and writes two bytes into a 32-byte-stride table cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9C1C
name: record_maximum_slot_value
description: Stores a byte in a table entry and a matching cell, then raises a stored maximum for that entry's second index to the entry's word when the word is larger.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9CC2
name: update_squares_by_piece_type
description: Makes a set of routine calls that update squares from the argument words, choosing between a square and a stored value by flag. A piece type of one or six takes separate paths that update further squares.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9DD0
name: build_attack_offset_table
description: Clears a lookup table, then fills entries for each of the eight direction offsets and their repeats, using two stored step values and a stored code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9EE2
name: check_line_of_attack
description: For piece type six it calls a routine and returns one when the result equals one. For other types it checks a stored attack-table entry and walks along the step from the origin square until a non-empty square or the target is reached, returning one when the target is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:9FC4
name: check_adjacent_pawn_attack
description: Adjusts the square by a stored step and returns one when a piece of type six sits on one of two squares next to the adjusted square, otherwise zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A062
name: check_square_under_attack
description: Returns one when a routine reports the square as occupied. Otherwise it checks each attacker recorded for that square and returns one when any of them passes a called routine's test.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A108
name: report_timed_out_routine
description: The pseudo-code could not be produced, so the behaviour is not known from the evidence. The routine is 36 instructions long, calls one unnamed routine, and is called from two unnamed routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A178
name: find_matching_square_index
description: Checks whether the argument's square and piece value match a stored entry, then walks back through the list for the same square. It returns a position code when found and a flag otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A20E
name: test_entry_is_eligible
description: Returns true when the entry's first word is zero, its flag byte is zero, and its type byte is neither zero nor six.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A266
name: count_entries_until_test_fails
description: Counts how many entries, stepping back from the current position, pass a called test before one fails, and returns that count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A2A2
name: scan_square_runs_for_count
description: Scans stored squares in pairs, compares their values, and calls routines to test candidate ranks. It returns a count of the runs it accepts, or one when the scan reaches its limit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A480
name: return_word_from_frame
description: Returns a word stored two bytes below the caller's frame pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A488
name: check_special_move_conditions
description: Tests a candidate move against special-move rules by comparing piece types and squares and calling routines for the remaining conditions. It returns a flag word, set when the move qualifies.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_pair_to_record_list
description: When the list holds fewer than eighty entries, it appends the stored pair to the list and increments its count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: run_routine_for_codes
description: Sets a flag word to one, then for each state code from two through five stores it in a state byte and calls a routine. It clears the flag word at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: generate_candidate_moves
description: Stores the piece at a source square, then tests the candidate squares around it using a step table. It calls routines to record each candidate move and to examine the squares in sequence, then calls further routines for the chosen candidates.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: generate_moves_by_piece_type
description: Stores the type of the piece on a selected square, then switches on that type to walk the candidate squares for it. Each type applies its own offsets and step counts, calling a routine for each square reached, and returns a status value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: refresh_attack_map_state
description: Clears two counters, then walks the stored entries of the current side and calls routines for each marked square. It repeats the walk for the opposing side and, when a flag byte is set, scans squares near a midpoint with a routine check.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: load_next_stored_pair
description: Loads the next stored position pair from the list when one remains, otherwise loads the default pair from globals.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: return_lowest_bit
description: Returns the least significant bit of the argument's low word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:AE68
name: evaluate_board_position_scores
description: Sums piece values and position terms for each side and fills per-square score tables. It then accumulates scores along rays from each square and calls routines for the results. The pseudo-code was truncated, so this covers only the visible parts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BC08
name: count_bits_accepted_by_routine
description: Shifts a 16-bit value right one bit at a time, up to its highest set bit, and calls a routine for each bit position. It counts the positions for which the routine returns a non-zero value and returns that count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BC36
name: combine_three_weights_negated
description: Calls a routine three times, then returns the negated weighted sum of the three results, using weights of eight, twenty and forty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: lookup_weighted_table_entry
description: Computes a table offset from fields of its two arguments, then returns a value from that table added to a per-index weight.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: update_bitmask_and_diff
description: Stores the complement of a state word and merges it into a mask word in a per-index table, clears bits of a second entry, then returns the difference between two routine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: update_bitmask_pair_and_diff
description: Clears one mask word from a state value, sets and clears bits of two table entries using a complemented word, then returns the difference of two routine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: score_move_delta
description: Computes a score change for a candidate move from its piece type, square and state values. It adds fixed bonuses for some piece types, subtracts a penalty when a flag applies, and returns the difference of two routine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: search_moves_with_score_window
description: Searches candidate moves by repeatedly calling move generation and evaluation routines and narrowing a pair of score bounds. It stops at a count limit or when a cut-off result is returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_search_result_acceptable
description: Returns zero when a flag is clear, or when a score is below a stored bound and the side's state is one. Otherwise it returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: clear_and_locate_kings
description: Clears a table of 24 two-entry records and sets two saved square words to minus one. It then scans each row of the board for type-six pieces and records the square of one for each side.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: store_result_when_unflagged
description: Sets a flag word from a stored byte, clears a counter, and calls a routine with the argument. It stores the result in a state word when the counter is zero, then returns the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: report_undecoded_search_step
description: The pseudo-code could not be produced, so the behaviour is not known from the evidence. The routine is 122 instructions long, calls four unnamed routines, and is called from two unnamed routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C604
name: search_candidate_moves_for_side
description: Checks a stored move entry and, depending on the side's state codes, tries candidate moves from the current move list. Each candidate is tested with called routines, and the search returns early once one is accepted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: run_recursive_move_search
description: Runs a loop over the move list at the current search depth, applying each move with the sides swapped, calling move generation and evaluation routines, recording scores and undoing each move afterwards. It returns one when a stop flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: record_search_candidate_pair
description: When a flag byte is set and the current entry differs from the argument, it saves the argument in one of two slots. The earlier entry is moved along when a called test allows it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: check_pending_moves_against_position
description: Returns one when a state-driven check against the current move, or against either of two saved entries, succeeds through a called test. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: raise_maximum_when_within_limit
description: Returns one when the argument does not exceed a stored limit, and raises a second stored value to the argument when that is larger. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: step_search_at_current_ply
description: Handles one search step: it decides whether to stop, extend or try the current candidate by calling evaluation and move routines. It updates the step's score and cut-off fields and returns one when the search should end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: adjust_search_score_by_ply
description: At search ply one, it classifies two counts into a multiplier and adds a scaled term to two state fields. It returns one and clears a state field when a count exceeds two, or when a deeper ply's called test returns more than one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: save_state_entry_and_update
description: Copies a stored two-longword entry into the state record for the current index. At index zero it records a saved word, and updates a second stored word when a mode value equals five.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: try_piece_codes
description: Sets a marker word for the current index to one, then calls a routine for each code from two through five, storing each code in a state byte. It returns one when a call succeeds, otherwise it clears the marker and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:D45A
name: scan_attack_entries_for_square
description: Stores the square and piece type in a move record, then tests candidate squares around it with a step table, calling routines for each reachable square. It then scans the stored move list in reverse, calling routines for each non-empty entry, and returns one as soon as a routine reports success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:D6D2
name: generate_piece_targets_by_type
description: Records a piece's square, type and flags in a move record, then switches on the piece type to walk its target squares. Types two to four use one set of offsets and type six uses another, and the routine returns one as soon as a call reports success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:DAF2
name: try_each_code_for_square
description: Sets a record for the current index and walks a table of square pairs in reverse, calling a routine on each pair. It returns one when a routine and a second check both succeed, otherwise zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:DBE6
name: check_midpoint_squares_for_six
description: When a stored entry has type six and passes a called test, it computes the midpoint of two squares and tests the squares around it with routine calls. It returns one when both tests succeed on one of those squares.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_slot_swaps
description: Walks back through a saved count, swapping two stored slot numbers and calling a routine for each step. It calls one more routine when a flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:DDFE
name: replay_slot_swaps
description: Calls a routine when a flag is set, then steps forward to the saved count, calling a routine for each entry and swapping the two stored slot numbers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:DE7A
name: show_result_message_and_clear
description: Calls routines to read a result. When a stored value is nonzero it shows a message through a routine call, or sets a result flag when the state value equals two. It clears the stored value and calls one more routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:E084
name: animate_piece_move_steps
description: Works out the direction and distance of a piece move from its start and end squares, then calls routines for each animation step. Piece types three, five and six have special handling. The pseudo-code was truncated, so this covers only the visible parts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F17C
name: store_two_channel_handles
description: Calls a routine with a pointer to a state block and the value seven, and another with eight, then stores each returned value in a state longword.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F1B4
name: run_when_flag_clear
description: When a state word is zero, calls two routines in sequence. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F1D4
name: write_config_when_flag_set
description: Calls a routine, then when a state word is nonzero, writes one of two sets of values to fixed targets according to the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F1EC
name: program_audio_channel_one
description: Programs audio channel one by writing its sample address, length, period and volume registers, then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits. A flag selects between two channel-setup paths.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F248
name: program_audio_channel_zero
description: Programs audio channel zero by writing its sample address, length, period and volume registers, then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F2A0
name: enable_audio_dma_for_channel
description: Sets the DMA and interrupt enable bits for one of two audio channel groups, chosen by the argument, then calls a routine with the value two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F2BC
name: enable_audio_dma_group_zero
description: Writes the DMA and interrupt enable bits for the first audio channel group, then calls a routine with the value two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F2DA
name: reset_audio_channel_volumes
description: Enables two audio channel DMA bits, zeroes two channel volume registers, then makes two library calls with stored values. The library routines are reached only through their offsets.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F31A
name: set_audio_slot_parameters
description: Sets a parameter word to 256 in the structure at its first argument. On the first call for the current state it stores a global pointer and the value 50, otherwise it sets a second parameter pair to 256 and 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F33E
name: set_slot_pointer_and_count
description: Stores a pointer taken from a global into the structure at its argument and sets a count field to 50.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F34E
name: set_alternate_slot_parameters
description: Sets a parameter word to 128 in the structure at its first argument. On the first call it stores a global pointer and the value 50, otherwise it sets a second parameter pair to 128 and 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F372
name: store_global_pointer_with_count
description: Stores a pointer taken from a global into the structure at its argument and sets a count field to 50.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F5DA
name: lookup_masked_table_value
description: Returns zero when the index is above 95. Otherwise it searches a list of tables for one whose mask matches a flag word, reads the entry at the index, and returns it with extra high bits set when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F5F2
name: lookup_masked_table_entry
description: Searches a list of tables for one whose mask matches a flag word, reads the entry at the index argument, and returns it with extra high bits set when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F62A
name: initialise_disk_port_access
description: The referenced text names the trackdisk device and a disk-port initialisation failure, so the routine appears to open disk access. Its pseudo-code could not be produced, so the exact steps are not known; it calls five unnamed routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F74C
name: store_pair_and_clear_global
description: Copies the two words of its 32-bit argument into two global words and clears a third global word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F76A
name: store_longword_and_clear
description: Stores its 32-bit argument in a global longword and clears the global word that follows it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F780
name: copy_data_in_blocks
description: Transfers a byte count in blocks of 512, calling routines for each block and advancing the source and destination addresses and the global counters. A remainder block is handled after the full blocks.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F89A
name: advance_blocks_with_block_numbers
description: Loops over a byte count in 512-byte steps, calling a routine for each step with a computed block number, then advances a global counter and the address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F8C2
name: call_routine_per_512_block
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with a stored pair of values, adding 512 to a global counter and advancing the pair until the remaining count is no longer positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F8F8
name: flush_pending_global_value
description: When a global value is nonzero it passes that value to a routine. Otherwise, when a second global pointer is nonzero, it makes two calls and passes that pointer to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F914
name: release_pending_global_handle
description: When a global handle value is nonzero, makes two calls, then passes a fixed address and the handle to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:F93E
name: adjust_block_offset_and_move
description: Rounds a global offset up to a 512-byte boundary and computes a block index from it. When the new value differs, it calls routines to handle the change and stores the new value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FA06
name: queue_block_transfer_type_two
description: Sets up a 512-byte transfer request by writing a command word of type two, the length, the target address and a block offset to globals, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FA3A
name: queue_block_transfer_type_three
description: Sets up a 512-byte transfer request by writing a command word of type three, the length, the target address and a block offset to globals, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FA6C
name: wait_for_writable_disk
description: Repeatedly checks the disk and shows the write-protected message through a routine call until the check passes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FAA4
name: run_single_disk_routine
description: Calls a single routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FAD0
name: wait_for_game_disk_insert
description: Waits while a drive status code equals 29, showing the insert-disk message through a routine call and pausing briefly before checking again. It returns when the status is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FB4C
name: check_game_disk_present
description: Saves a 13-longword block, issues disk commands with fixed values, checks the result of a routine call, and restores the block. It returns one when the check succeeds and zero otherwise; the referenced text is the game title.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FC58
name: check_saved_game_file
description: Saves a 13-longword block, issues disk commands using a computed value and the saves-file text, checks a result, and restores the block. It returns one when the check succeeds and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FD34
name: restore_saved_block_and_succeed
description: Copies a stored 13-longword block from the caller's frame into a fixed buffer, calls a routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FD36
name: restore_block_and_clear_global
description: Copies a stored 13-longword block from the caller's frame into a fixed buffer, clears a global word, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FD52
name: save_global_then_restore_block
description: Stores a global longword in the caller's frame, copies a 13-longword block from the frame into a fixed buffer, calls a routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FD80
name: send_command_type_four
description: Writes a command word of type four to a global and calls a routine with a fixed buffer address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FD9C
name: reset_and_send_command_nine
description: When a global is zero, writes a command word of type nine and clears another global, then calls a routine with a fixed buffer address.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FDC8
name: set_global_to_minus_one
description: Sets a global longword to minus one and returns that value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FDE0
name: build_request_block_and_send
description: Fills a local request block, sets two of its header bytes to fixed values, and passes the block to a routine with a length of 32.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FE24
name: wait_for_saves_disk_insert
description: Repeatedly checks for the saves disk and shows the insert-disk message through a routine call until the check passes. It then pauses briefly if the message was shown.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FE4E
name: pause_when_flag_set
description: When a stored word is nonzero, makes a delay call with the value 300. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FE7E
name: clear_global_word
description: Clears a global word to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FE8C
name: report_empty_saved_games
description: Reads a 512-byte saves block. If that fails it shows the no-saved-games message. Otherwise it fills eight saved-game entries from the block and runs a selection loop over them until an entry is chosen or the final entry ends the loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FEC2
name: run_load_game_selection
description: Runs a selection loop over eight saved-game entries for loading, using library calls for input and drawing. It highlights the chosen entry and returns once a selection is confirmed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FFAA
name: navigate_saved_game_list
description: Continues the saved-game selection loop. It refreshes the highlighted entry through library calls, moves to the chosen entry, and restores the display state before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FFD0
name: highlight_saved_game_entry
description: Highlights the current saved-game entry through library calls when a selection is set, then restores the display state once the loop finishes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FFE4
name: select_saved_game_entry
description: Runs the saved-game selection loop until an entry is chosen, drawing each entry through library calls and restoring the display state afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:FFE6
name: wait_for_saved_game_choice
description: Keeps the saved-game selection loop running until the highlighted entry changes or a selection is made, then redraws the list and restores the display state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10006
name: poll_saved_game_selection
description: Polls the saved-game list for a changed highlight using library calls, drawing the new entry and restoring the display state when the list is exited.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10012
name: handle_saved_game_input_event
description: Handles a list input event. When the event code is 64 it moves the highlight or ends the list. Otherwise it fetches the next event through library calls and continues the loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10028
name: redraw_selected_saved_game
description: Draws the currently selected saved-game entry through library calls, then clears a display flag word and the eight entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:100CE
name: run_save_game_dialog
description: Runs the save-game dialog. It lets the user type a name of up to fourteen characters for a save slot, handling the backspace and return keys, then copies the name into the chosen slot and draws it through library calls.
